abilities.name: Hammer of Wrath
abilities.text: When you charge into melee using your jump pack, all enemies 2 metres of the point where you land must pass an Agility test (DN 2 +Rank) or be knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Hunters Unleashed
abilities.text: The Chapters kinship with wolves extends to enhanced senses and an almost feral fighting style replete with savage grace. You have the Acute Sense Talent (p.129) and the Dual Wield Talent (p.133).

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Courage (+1 Resolve); Accomplishment Crusader (+1 Determination); Goal Honour the Chapter (+1 Conviction).

talents.name: Bolter Discipline
talents.text: When you use a weapon with the BOLT Keyword, it gains the Rapid Fire (2) Trait. If the weapon already has the Rapid Fire Trait, add +Rank to the weapon's Rapid Fire rating.

talents.name: Built Tough
talents.text: You can use Survival (Wil) instead of Medicae (Int) to remove your own Wounds, Shock, or Conditions … You do not suffer the usual DN penalties for using this ability on yourself.

talents.name: Hammer of Wrath
talents.text: When equipped with a Jump Pack (Wrath & Glory Core Rulebook, page 237), you may spend one Wrath to make any attack you make as part of a flying Charge deal Mortal Wounds for damage.

talents.name: Acute Sense (smell)
talents.text: Whenever you make an Awareness Test based on that sense, you gain +Rank bonus dice.

talents.name: Dual Wield
talents.text: When you wield one weapon in each hand the DN penalty for using the Multi-Attack option is reduced by 2. Each weapon must have the Pistol Trait or be a one-handed melee weapon. You may also use a different weapon you are wielding for each of your Multi-Attacks, rolling damage separately for each weapon.

gear: Jump Pack (Core p.237): using your Movement, fly at double Speed with a DN 3 Pilot (A) Test, ignoring terrain; a failure scatters (p.186); a Complication crashes (1d3+ Shock and falling damage)
Chaplet Ecclesiasticus (Rubicon Uncommon item, Core p.237): his penitent's chaplet; can be used as a Symbol of Authority (p.240) or a garrote
Hellfire Bolt rounds (+3 ED against organic targets, +2 ED against inorganic, Core p.230; BOLT weapons only)
